descriptionHtml:
ASUS Prime B850M-A WIFI mATX Motherboard (AMD Socket AM5 / Supports Ryzen 9000, 8000 & 7000 Series / 4x DDR5 Slots / PCIe 5.0 M.2 Slot / Wi-Fi 6E & 2.5Gb Ethernet / USB 20Gbps Type-C / Aura Sync RGB / 1 Year Warranty)

Empower your high-performance PC build with the ASUS Prime B850M-A WIFI mATX motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Engineered to unlock the full power of AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series desktop processors on socket AM5, this motherboard offers comprehensive power delivery, robust cooling solutions, and intelligent tuning options. Packed with next-generation connectivity including PCIe 5.0 M.2 storage, ultra-fast Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5Gb Ethernet, and rear USB 20Gbps Type-C ports, it ensures top-tier performance for daily productivity, content creation, and high-speed gaming.

Storage Interfaces1x M.2 PCIe 5.0 x4 Slot / 1x M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 Slot / 4x SATA 6Gbps Ports
Networking & WirelessWi-Fi 6E (2x2) + Bluetooth 5.3 + Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet LAN
Rear I/O Connectivity1x USB 20Gbps Type-C, 2x USB 10Gbps Type-A, 4x USB 2.0, 1x DisplayPort, 1x HDMI, 1x 2.5G LAN, 3x Audio Jacks
